title: Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:

Year ____ Month ____ Day ____ Applicant: ____________________ (Signature or seal) To the Head of the Tax Office Power of Attorney I authorize the person specified below to act in matters concerning the [ ] regular / [ ] amended / [ ] late Tax Base Return for Taxable Articles. Principal (applicant): ____________________ (Signature or seal) | Tax representative: Name (business name) | Business registration number | Control number | Date of birth | Telephone number | |---|---|---|---|---| | | | | | | Attachments: 1. Statement of Total Releases of Taxable Articles (Attached Schedule 1): one copy. 2. Statement of Product Receipts and Issues and Releases without Payment of Tax or under Tax Exemption (Attached Schedule 2): one copy. 3. Application for Credit (Refund) of Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax (Attached Form No. 18): one copy, only where a credit or refund is requested. Fee: None. 210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²] (Reverse) Instructions for Completion ※ Complete this return in Korean and Arabic numerals, and state amounts to the nearest won. The business must not complete the grey-shaded fields. 1. Enter the results for the relevant month for taxable articles falling under Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act. 2. The business must not complete the control-number field. 3. Complete the resident (alien) registration number field only where an individual who is not a business operator files the return. 4. For a business operator, enter the location of the manufacturing place or sales place in the address (place of business) field; for an individual who is not a business operator, enter the individual's address. 5. For (1) Taxable release, enter the respective totals of the tax bases and calculated tax amounts for taxable issues in the Statement of Total Releases of Taxable Articles. 6. For (2) Tax-exempt release, enter the respective totals of the tax bases and calculated tax amounts for tax-exempt issues in that statement. 7. For (3) Release without payment of tax, enter the respective totals of the tax bases and calculated tax amounts for issues without payment of tax in that statement. 8. For (4) Exempt tax amount, enter the total exempt tax for tax-exempt issues in that statement. 9. For (5) Unpaid tax amount, enter the total unpaid tax for issues without payment of tax in that statement. 10. In (6), (7), and (9), enter the respective additional taxes under the Framework Act on National Taxes. 11. In (8), enter as the tax base the total traffic, energy and environment tax payable for the rows in the Statement of Total Releases of Taxable Articles in which education tax is entered; enter the total education tax in that statement as calculated tax. 12. Complete the report-of-closure section only if the business operator has closed the business and is reporting the closure. 13. In the tax representative's control-number field, enter the control number assigned upon registration in the register of certified tax accountants or the register of tax representation services under Article 6 or 20-2 of the Certified Tax Accountant Act. However, through December 31, 2025, leave the control-number field blank and enter the date of birth in the date-of-birth field instead. 14. Complete the tax representative's date-of-birth field only if there is no control number. Enter the date of birth of the tax representative; if the tax representative is a corporation, enter the date of birth of its certified tax accountant or other affiliated person responsible for this return of taxable-article tax-base results. Processing Procedure
Person filing the returnIntermediate institutionProcessing authority: Tax office having jurisdiction over the place of business
A. Prepare and submit returnB. Bank of Korea or postal officeC. Receive return (Department responsible for taxpayer assistance)
D. Arrange and verify internal documents (Department responsible for tax-base management)
E. National Tax Service computer room
The return follows A → C. The payment-slip branch follows A → B → C. Processing then follows C → D → E; the D → E arrow is labelled “Notification.” 210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²] ■ Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [Attached Form No. 4, Attached Schedule 1] (Page 1 of 3) Statement of Total Releases of Taxable Articles | Control number | - | Business registration number (taxpayer number) | | |---|---|---|---| | Tax period | Results for Year ____ Month ____ | Business name (corporate name) | |

297 mm × 210 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²] (Page 2 of 3) Instructions for Completion ① Release category: Starting at the top of the first page of the statement, enter taxable releases, tax-exempt releases, and releases without payment of tax in that order. ② Classification code: Refer to the classification-code table on page 3 and enter the code for taxable release, the type of reduction/exemption, release without payment of tax, unconditional exemption, or conditional exemption. ※ Taxable release codes: 300001 — taxable release; 300002 — taxable own consumption. ※ Reduction/exemption/release-without-payment codes: See the classification-code table. ※ No-activity code: 300009 — no activity. ③ Year/month of release: Enter the year, month, and day on which the taxable articles are released. ④ Name of taxable article: Enter the name of the articles released. In doing so, enter the articles in each subparagraph of Article 2 (1) of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act separately as gasoline, substitute oil similar to gasoline, diesel, or substitute oil similar to diesel. ⑤ Specifications: Enter the specifications of the articles. ⑥ Quantity: Enter the quantity released. ⑦ Unit price: Enter the amount per liter of the taxable articles. ⑧ Release price: Enter the release price of the taxable articles, calculated as ⑥ quantity × ⑦ unit price. ⑨ Tax base: Enter the quantity obtained by deducting the natural-decrease quantity under Article 6 of the Enforcement Decree of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act from the quantity released. ⑩ Tax rate: Enter the tax rate under Article 2 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act. ⑪ Calculated tax: Enter ⑨ tax base × ⑩ tax rate. ⑫ Exempt / unpaid tax: Enter the tax exempted or unpaid under the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act. ⑬ Tax credit / reduction: Enter the tax credit under Article 17 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [complete separately for each reason code for a credit (refund) in Attached Form No. 18] and the tax reduction/exemption under the Restriction of Special Taxation Act. ⑭ Tax payable: Enter ⑪ calculated tax − ⑫ exempt / unpaid tax − ⑬ tax credit / reduction. ⑮ Education tax: Complete only for articles subject to education tax; calculate as ⑭ tax payable × the education tax rate. ⑯ Particulars of receiving party (taxpayer number): Enter the business registration number or resident registration number of the purchaser who received the released articles. ⑰ Release approval / entry certificate number: For releases without payment of tax, under exemption for sales places exclusively for foreigners, or under conditional exemption, enter the entry approval number. For unconditional or diplomatic exemption, enter the release approval number. For export or military supply, enter the release approval number if a release approval certificate has been issued. metadata.author_method: Exact held-source units translated or completed using explicitly recorded source/target spans; original official records remain unchanged. All new units are MACHINE_TRANSLATION and UNREVIEWED.

visual_reconciliation_overlay.translated_annotation: All six original GIF pages are retained in this translation. The six circled Korean tax labels are rendered A–F in source order; the actual formulas are D=A−B−C and total=D−E+F. The source's question marks represent subtraction signs, while missing header numbers are restored as ⑬–⑰ from the images. Attached Schedule 1 has 17 columns and 14 blank input rows; its four classification-code groups retain 13 aligned rows, comprising 8/11/7/6 entries and 5/2/6/7 blank tails. Attached Schedule 2 has 19 columns and 9 blank input rows. The source says year/month in field ③ and year/month/day in its instruction; both are retained. The grey-shaded-field prohibition and three-lane payment-slip branch are included. The final Korean suffix of the printed form-control code is transliterated as il.
